messages:
rachel (AE): Heads up 1: APAC POC (gov-org) just hit two blockers: they pinned to `redwood-mistral-30b:v2024-11-01` and now get deprecation/availability errors in ap-southeast-1. Also seeing sporadic 429 spikes. Can we triage?

 tom (SE): Paste the exact client payload and error text? Are they pinning by full tag or by a commit-like string?

 rachel (AE): Payload from their integration test: 
```json
{"model":"redwood-mistral-30b:v2024-11-01","region":"ap-southeast-1","prompt":"summarize..."}
```
SDK error: `403 ModelDeprecatedError: redwood-mistral-30b:v2024-11-01 has been deprecated in ap-southeast-1; see docs`
They also posted: `HTTP 429: RateLimitExceeded` during batch runs.

 kyle (Infra): Quick check: that specific tagged build was deprecated in APAC last month due to memory regression with our custom kernel. We have a replacement `redwood-mistral-30b:v2025-01-12` (non-deprecated) and a quantized `-quant` variant. Pinned exact tags block automatic routing/fallback.

 tom (SE): For the 429s, logs show their test harness opens 40 concurrent streams; APAC tenant concurrency default is 20. Retries are aggressive which causes bursts.

 rachel (AE): Customer insists on that exact tag because their compliance suite expects identical tokenizer and logits for audit. They also submitted a security questionnaire asking about HSM integration and dedicated VPC endpoints.

 meera (Security): HSM (BYOK) and dedicated VPC endpoints are only available on Dedicated/Private plans. Hosted doesn't provide customer HSMs. We can provide audit artifacts for hosted but not customer-managed HSM keys. VPC endpoints are available on Dedicated with the network add-on.

 dan (CS): They prefer hosted for initial speed. Would it help if we explain the fallback: allow `model_fallback` to `redwood-mistral-30b:v2025-01-12` for most tests and run a subset of audit tests on Dedicated later?

 tom (SE): Two short-term options: 1) ask them to use the compatible alias `redwood-mistral-30b:stable-apac` which maps to the supported build; 2) reduce concurrency in their harness; 3) request quota increase for their account in ap-southeast-1. I can prepare a small regression harness to compare outputs across builds.

 kyle (Infra): Ops note: redeploying the old v2024-11-01 non-quant in APAC requires kernel backport and safety validation. Estimate 3-5 business days if we prioritize. Temporary quota bump request can be processed in ~same-day if infra approves.

 meera (Security): If they require HSM-backed signing for audit, that's a Dedicated/Private only feature. We'll need to loop legal for an addendum if we provision Dedicated with BYOK.

 rachel (AE): Customer asked: "Can you prove exact equivalence between old tag and new tag?" Also they want a timeline for Dedicated trial + cost.

 tom (SE): We cannot guarantee bitwise equivalence across builds (kernels/quantization differ). But we can: 1) provide a regression diff report on their sample set; 2) run a controlled Dedicated instance with the old artifact and capture hashes/outputs for their compliance team.

 dan (CS): I'll draft a 30-day Dedicated trial quote (small pool) and loop finance. If they go Dedicated we can enable VPC and BYOK for their env.

 infra-bot: quota-request INF-1234 created by dan (CS): increase concurrency in ap-southeast-1 by +30 for account acct-99321. Pending approval.

 kyle (Infra): Approved tentative approach: immediate - offer `stable-apac` alias + temporary quota bump + ask them to drop concurrency; medium - run regression harness on quant vs non-quant; long - if audit fails, schedule Dedicated trial and backport (3-5 days).

 rachel (AE): I'll send customer an email with three clear paths (1. use alias & bump 2. Dedicated trial 3. ops backport) and ask which audit tests must be exact so we can prioritize.

 tom (SE): I'll prepare a small harness and a step-by-step guide they can run. Should take ~90 mins for them to produce diff artifacts.

 dan (CS): On it 1. Also pinged finance for trial pricing.

 meera (Security): I'll compile the questionnaire answers for hosted vs Dedicated (HSM/VPC differences) and include required contacts for key-rotation.

 rachel (AE): Thanks all. cc'ing customer and legal. Will update when they select path. :white_check_mark:
